title: Muzzle Direction Safety Quiz
body:
🎯 Alright, GAFC fam, pop quiz time! 🎯 You just finished cleaning your firearm, and Bobo Licious is over here blastin' his new mixtape, got you vibin'. Before you secure that piece, which direction should its muzzle ALWAYS be pointed? 🤔

A) At the floor (it's empty, right?)
B) At the ceiling (ain't nobody up there)
C) In the safest available direction, away from anything you don't intend to shoot.

This ain't just a rule, it's a sacred trust. It's about guarding your blessings & preserving the peace in your home and community, just like our elders at Church of Legacy teach us. Drop your answer in the comments! Let's keep our loved ones safe and our communities strong. 💪

#GAFC #GunSafetyIsCommunitySafety #ResponsibleGunOwnership #CommunityFirst #ProtectYourLegacy #BlackAndBrownGuns
